gates.reference: NSC-014 VAL-001; GDD - Development Agent Roles (Unity Validation Agent)
gates.requirement: Assets/NoSafeCircle/DoorPrototype/Tests/EnemyPursuitPlayModeTests.cs uses a temporary NavMesh-baked scene and the production EnemyTargetKnowledge and EnemyPursuitMovement components to verify pursuit after acquisition, last-known-position movement after distance-based target loss, bounded randomized movement on navigable points, reacquisition, return to idle after search expires, and complete reset through ResetPursuit().

gates.reference: NSC-014 VAL-003; GDD - Door and Pursuit Rules
gates.requirement: Assets/NoSafeCircle/DoorPrototype/Tests/EnemyPursuitDoorCrossingPlayModeTests.cs uses temporary scene objects with NSC-089's GameplayNavigationSurface and NSC-090's DoorEnemyPassability. It verifies that a pursuing or searching enemy follows the player or last-known position through an open or broken doorway without clearing its target solely because of the crossing. The test does not save or modify Assets/Scenes/DoorPrototype.unity.
